product.title: Reef Snorkel & Ocean Paddle Adventure in Fort Lauderdale Beach

description.text: South Florida is home to colorful marine life and reef systems just offshore, and this small-group experience combines paddleboarding with guided snorkeling so you can enjoy both. After a quick orientation, paddle out with your guide, learn how to spot coral habitats and local fish, and then snorkel above reef sections in calm coastal water. Your guide shares ecosystem context throughout and captures complimentary photos so you can stay focused on the water. This relaxed outing is ideal for travelers who want a hands-on ocean activity with instruction, wildlife interpretation, and plenty of time to explore Lauderdale-By-The-Sea from the water.

highlights: Explore Florida’s marine life on a small-group paddle and snorkel tour
Learn reef and marine ecosystem context from your guide while on the water
All core paddleboarding and snorkeling equipment is provided
Receive complimentary photos from your guide after the experience

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point for the tour?
faqs.answer: Meet at 4244 El Mar Dr, Lauderdale-By-The-Sea, FL 33308. Contact the operator after booking to confirm start details and conditions.

faqs.question: How long does the reef and snorkel paddle tour last?
faqs.answer: The experience lasts about 2 hours 30 minutes, including guided paddle and snorkel time.

faqs.question: Is equipment included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paddleboard and snorkeling equipment are included, and complimentary photos are provided by the guide.

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for most travelers?
faqs.answer: The tour is designed for most travelers and runs in a small-group format, with a maximum of 10 participants.
